name: web-search-mcp
description: Multi-provider web search MCP server for Bun

scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build:runtime: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/server.ts --outfile dist/server.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/registry.ts --outfile dist/registry.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/providers/index.ts --outfile dist/providers/index.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/providers/base.ts --outfile dist/providers/base.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/providers/kimi.ts --outfile dist/providers/kimi.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/providers/zai.ts --outfile dist/providers/zai.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/providers/volces.ts --outfile dist/providers/volces.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/providers/tencentmaas.ts --outfile dist/providers/tencentmaas.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/providers/aliyuncs.ts --outfile dist/providers/aliyuncs.js --target bun --format esm
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:runtime && bun run build:types
